title: Toys R Us Recalls Children’s Sandals Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The butterfly wings on the children's sandals can rip and detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 19,000.

title: Women’s Scarves Recalled by Zazou Scarves Due to Burn Hazard; Violation of Federal Flammability Standard
summary: The scarves fail to meet the federal flammability standard for wearing apparel and pose a risk of burn injury to consumers. Units: About 3,800.

title: American Honda Recalls Recreational Off-Highway Vehicles Due to Fire Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: Vegetation and debris can accumulate on the middle skid plate and make contact with the vehicle's exhaust system. Dried debris can ignite, resulting in smoke or fire. Units: About 15,400.

title: Briggs & Stratton Recalls Snapper Rear Engine Riding Mowers Due to Injury Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: Weld on drive axle can fail resulting in loss of brake control, posing an injury hazard. Units: About 8,500.

title: Sanus Simplicity Television Wall Mounts Recalled by Milestone AV Technologies Due to Impact Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Costco
summary: The nut securing the television to the main arm assembly can loosen causing the attached television to become detached from the arm assembly, posing an impact hazard. Units: About 207,000.

title: Michaels Stores Recalls Folding Tables Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The folding tables can collapse under excessive weight, posing an impact or falling hazard. Units: About 8,400.

title: Toys R Us Recalls Toy Toaster Sets Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The plastic toast, under pressure, can crack and break into small pieces creating sharp edges and posing a choking hazard. Units: About 30,000 in the U.S. and about 6,000 in Canada.

title: Dimension Industries Recalls Sling Café Sets Due to Fall Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Costco (Recall Alert)
summary: The recalled chairs can break due to a missing metal washer plate, posing a fall hazard to consumers. Units: About 18,000.

title: Louis Garneau Recalls Aerodynamic Bicycle Helmets Due to Injury Hazard
summary: In cold temperatures, the helmet can fail to protect the wearer from impact injuries. Units: About 1,180 helmets.

title: Fluid Handling Recalls Low Water Cut-Off Control Units for Hot Water or Steam Boilers Due to Fire and Explosion Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: The ground wire and probe wires could be incorrectly assembled in the units by the manufacturer, posing fire and explosion hazards. Units: About 1,200.

title: Rejuvenation Recalls Hanging Lamps Due to Risk of Injury (Recall Alert)
summary: The cord system can fail to support the weight of the pendant causing it to fall, posing the risk of injury. Units: About 85.

title: Fiskars Recalls Bypass Lopper Shears Due to Laceration Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Home Depot
summary: The lopper handles can break when attempting to cut branches, posing a risk of serious injury and laceration. Units: About 277,000 in the U.S. and 11,000 in Canada.

title: PAB Two Recalls Bed Bug Heat Treatment Systems Due to Fire Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The flexible, electrical conducting strip at the top of the heating element can break at the corners after multiple setups, posing an electrical fire hazard. Units: About 1,700.

title: KYMCO Recalls ATVs Due to Burn, Fire Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: In hot environments or high elevations, the fuel cap can fail to vent properly, causing the fuel to heat up and pressure to build up in the tank. The pressure can cause the fuel tank to rupture or the fuel to boil out of the tank onto the operator or hot engine, resulting in burns to the operator or

title: Cost Plus World Market Recalls Modular Storage Bars Due to Injury Hazard
summary: When weight is applied to the storage bar, the screws holding the mounting plate can pull out of the bar allowing the storage bar to fall, posing an injury hazard. Units: About 7,000.

title: Tectron International Recalls USB Chargers Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The charger can overheat while in use, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 55,000.

title: Visonic Recalls Amber Personal Emergency Response Pendants and Kits Due to Pendant Battery Failure
summary: An accelerated circuit drain of the pendant battery can result in a decreased battery life and shorter than expected "low battery" warning period, from 30 days down to a nine day warning period. Units: About 29,200.

title: Cane Creek Recalls Bicycle Shocks Due to Risk of Injury
summary: The shock absorber is marked with graphics that incorrectly identify the adjustment directions for High Speed Rebound (HSR) damping. Following these directions will cause unexpected behavior by a bike's suspension and pose a fall hazard to a rider. Units: About 5,000 in the US and 500 in Canada.

title: Waterway Plastics Recalls Spa Drain Suction Covers Due to Risk of Entrapment
summary: The drain suction cover can become disengaged from the spa wall, posing an entrapment hazard to consumers. Units: About 26,000.

title: Meijer Recalls Halloween Projector Flashlight Due to Burn Hazard
summary: The flashlight can overheat and melt the plastic handle, posing a burn risk to the user. Units: About 8,600.

title: Arctic Cat Recalls Single-Rider and 2UP ATVs Due To Crash Hazard
summary: Components in the front gear case can fail, posing a risk of loss of control and crash hazard. Units: About 40,000.
